Your holdings: SOXL (-85.49%), MUU (-72.09%), and SMH (-32.94%) are in deep drawdowns, with SOXL and MUU being leveraged and having stops that are completely out of sync with current prices. Margin amplifies these drops significantly.

Watch: Keep an eye on Treasury yields for market direction, and any further news on AI spending or tech sector sentiment.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged, deeply underwater positions.
plays: Review SOXL and MUU: Your stops at 200 and 31.6 respectively are far above current prices (32.6 and 10.38). These leveraged positions are deeply underwater; re-evaluate your risk tolerance and adjust stops immediately or consider exiting.
Address METU: This leveraged ETF is on "TRIM" status with a stop at 18.3, very close to its current price of 19.4. Respect the scanner's signal and consider trimming if it approaches the stop.
Consider a hedge with SPXS: The scanner flags SPXS (inverse S&P 500) as an ACCUMULATE at 28.73-28.7, stop 28.5. This could offer some downside protection given the tech sell-off concerns.
